title: Steps to create Transfer Within Bank – New Beneficiary

steps.text: Login to the mobile application, Land on accounts dashboard (account landed in the debit account number) and click Transfer
Click on New beneficiary – Enter Capital bank account number
A message will be displayed asking if this “Is a transfer within Capital Bank?” so  Customer must enter Yes to proceed
Enter beneficiary details ( Name, Purpose of Transfer) , Enter description (optional field)

Click on next to preview transfer details 
 a. Confirm: proceed with transfer  
 b. Back arrow to edit transfer details
Confirm Transfer and save beneficiary , Click on Add as Beneficiary
